title: 第15章 随时欢迎过夫妻生活第16章 助兴
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第15章随时欢迎，过夫妻生活哐当！
杯子碎了一地。
纪馨宁摔坐在地，痛苦捂着额头，鲜血从她指缝渗出，滴落在地板上。
“唐凝！你疯了！”
纪馨宁抬头怒瞪着她，歇斯底里吼了句，狰狞的面容被鲜血糊了一脸，再没了从前的娇柔。
唐凝从床上下来，走到她面前冷漠睨着她：“比起这些年你对我做的，没把你砸死，算便宜你了。”
她的眼神渗出冷冷的恨意，看得纪馨宁心头一怵。
她疼得大口大口喘气，并且变得暴躁：“我听不懂你在说什么！你敢砸伤我，纪寒哥哥知道，一定不会放过你，绝不会再跟你领证。”
唐凝居高临下的气势，清冷从容地冷笑出声：“不是他不跟我领证，是我唐凝，早就不要他了！”
“唐凝，你个贱人……”纪馨宁气得胸口剧烈起伏，半天说不出一句话。
病房门忽然被打开。
纪寒穿着名贵的蓝灰色西装进来，闻到空气里的血腥味，又看到纪馨宁这个模样，猛地一惊。
“二哥，你可算来了。”
纪馨宁也看到他了，愤恨的目光瞬间变得柔弱可怜，委屈的哭出来。
“怎么会弄成这样？”纪寒急忙蹲下来查看伤势。
纪馨宁哭得一抽一抽的，“不怪唐凝姐，是我不好，她让我跪下，我就应该跪下，不应该忤逆她的意思。”
唐凝心底冷笑，真是诡计多端。
她不甘示弱：“是你怕我跟纪寒领证，亲自过来告诉我，纪寒以后会跟我离婚，让我知难而退，不是吗？”
纪馨宁眼泪挂在眼睑下方，委屈又脆弱的哭腔道：“我没有……”
“没有？敢不敢把录音……”

“够了！”
没等唐凝把话说完，纪寒打断，“唐凝，你真是越来越歹毒，让我很怀疑，到底还该不该领证！”
纪寒暴怒的态度，前所未有的凶狠。
尽管这五年来，纪寒再如何不在意她，都不会这么对她说话。
唐凝错愕地看着他，像是在看一个陌生人。
曾经那个对父亲承诺，说会好好照顾她，疼爱她的少年，此刻对她充满了厌恶和憎恨。
顿时间，唐凝感到一阵恍惚。
她不是难过。
而是，害怕把她当做掌上明珠，含在嘴里怕化了，握在手里怕摔了的父母看到了，在天堂都要担心她。
“我以为你只是单纯的耍耍小性子，想不到你居然这么恨宁宁，对她下这么重手！”
纪寒直起身，冲着唐凝低吼，对她毫无怜惜。
唐凝嗤笑：“是，我是恨她，当然，我更讨厌你。”
“在我眼里，你们就是一对狗男女，般配！”
“你说什么！”
content_en:
Chapter 15 Welcome at any time, let’s live a happy life as husband and wife!
The cup shattered on the floor.
Ji Xinning fell to the ground, clutching her forehead in pain. Blood seeped out from between her fingers and dripped on the floor.
"Tang Ning! You are crazy!"
Ji Xinning raised her head and glared at her, shouting hysterically. Her ferocious face was covered in blood, and she no longer looked as gentle as before.
Tang Ning got off the bed, walked up to her and looked at her coldly: "Compared to what you have done to me over the years, I didn't beat you to death, which is an advantage for you."
There was cold hatred in her eyes, which made Ji Xinning feel frightened.
She gasped for air in pain and became irritable: "I don't understand what you are talking about! If you dare to hurt me, brother Ji Han knows that he will never let you go and will never collect a certificate from you again."
With a condescending aura, Tang Ning sneered coldly and calmly: "It's not that he didn't want to get the certificate from me, it's that I, Tang Ning, have given up on him a long time ago!"
"Tang Ning, you bitch..." Ji Xinning was so angry that her chest heaved violently, and she couldn't say a word for a long time.
The ward door was suddenly opened.
Ji Han came in wearing a luxurious blue-gray suit. He smelled the smell of blood in the air and was shocked when he saw Ji Xinning's appearance.
"Second brother, you are finally here."
Ji Xinning also saw him, her resentful eyes instantly became weak and pitiful, and she cried in grievance.
"How could it be like this?" Ji Han hurriedly knelt down to check the injury.
Ji Xinning cried so hard, "I don't blame Sister Tang Ning, it's my fault. She asked me to kneel down, so I should kneel down. I shouldn't disobey her."
Tang Ning sneered in her heart, she was really cunning.
Not to be outdone, she said: "You were afraid that I would get the certificate with Ji Han, so you came over to tell me personally that Ji Han would divorce me in the future, so that I could give up and give up, right?"
Ji Xinning's tears hung under her eyelids, and she cried with grievance and vulnerability: "I didn't..."
"No? Do you dare to record..."
"Enough!"
Before Tang Ning could finish her words, Ji Han interrupted, "Tang Ning, you are getting more and more vicious, which makes me doubt whether I should still get the certificate!"
Ji Han's furious attitude was unprecedentedly fierce.
Although Ji Han didn't care about her in the past five years, he would never speak to her like this.
Tang Ning looked at him in astonishment, as if looking at a stranger.
The boy who once promised his father that he would take good care of her and love her is now full of disgust and hatred for her.
For a moment, Tang Ning felt in a trance.
She is not sad.
Rather, the parents who are afraid of treating her as the apple of their eye, holding her in their mouths for fear of melting, holding her in their hands for fear of falling, will worry about her in heaven when they see her.
"I thought you were just being petty, but I didn't expect you to hate Ning Ning so much and treat her so harshly!"
Ji Han straightened up and growled at Tang Ning, showing no pity for her.
Tang Ning sneered: "Yes, I hate her. Of course, I hate you even more."
"In my eyes, you two are a perfect couple!"
"What did you say!"
